project: TrustLens — Company-Level Fake Review Detection, Sentiment Analysis and Review Intelligence System
academic_honesty_statement: Historical benchmark results documented from prior experimental evaluation stages on the complete source corpora. Values are preserved as recorded and not artificially inflated or synthesized.

fake_review_detection.split_methodology: Leakage-controlled train/test split with group disjointness safeguards

advanced_xgboost.notes: Encountered memory-allocation error on dense representation during training; gracefully disabled in production pipeline.

sentiment_analysis.evaluation_methodology: Leakage-controlled train/test evaluation with neutral-class optimization

latest_neutral_optimized_model.methodological_notes: Neutral class is inherently challenging due to severe class imbalance and ambiguous sentiment boundaries. Reporting macro F1 (74.61%) honestly reflects class-level performance alongside accuracy (90.47%).

aspect_based_sentiment_analysis.ground_truth_status: Ground-truth aspect annotations were unavailable in the source dataset. Aspect extraction operates via rule/lexicon-assisted syntax segmentation; confidence scores reflect heuristic matching certainty, not verified ground-truth accuracy.

similarity_and_duplicate_detection.engine: Character-level TF-IDF (3-5 n-grams) + Word-level TF-IDF (1-2 n-grams) cosine similarity
similarity_and_duplicate_detection.exact_duplicate_detection: Case- and punctuation-normalized whitespace bucket matching
similarity_and_duplicate_detection.optimization: Vectorizers are fit once during training and stored with the reference corpus; ordinary dashboard sessions query precomputed representations without redundant matrix recomputation.
